summary: Validated 'Mon profil / Préférences' feature end-to-end: per-user prefs storage, theme toggle+persistence across pages+reload, sort/scenario reflection in summary, reset, cross-user isolation (admin vs user1), and Rapports 4-tabs regression. Backend 7/7 pytest pass. Frontend Playwright: all assertions passed including PER-USER ISOLATION (admin remained dark while user1 switched himself to light). Both accounts reset to defaults (light theme, # asc sorts, scenario CA). 122 employees intact.

minor.issue: Sending an invalid (non-JSON) body returns HTTP 500 instead of 400/422 because `await request.json()` throws unhandled JSONDecodeError. Consider try/except -> HTTPException(400). Low priority.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Wrap `await request.json()` in PUT /api/me/preferences with a try/except to return 400 on malformed JSON instead of 500.
(Pre-existing from iter_13) Add `supervisor: Optional[str] = None` to EmployeeBase Pydantic model or stop sending it from the frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1673 lines — please split into routers (auth/prefs, users, employees, budget, reports).

Preferences model is a free-form dict (no Pydantic validation): any client can persist arbitrary keys/values under user.preferences. Consider a Pydantic PreferencesUpdate schema with whitelisted keys (theme in {light,dark}, budget_scenario in {actuel,ca,revue1,revue2}, employees_sort/budget_sort with key+dir enums) to prevent junk data on the user document.
test_credentials: admin@accslegro.com/admin123 and user1@accslegro.com/user123 (user1 was MISSING from DB at the start of testing; tester created it via admin API using the credentials documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Created user1@accslegro.com (role=user, password=user123) via POST /api/users because the account documented in test_credentials.md did not exist. Left in DB for future testing. Both admin and user1 preferences reset to defaults (theme=light, scenario=ca, sorts=# asc) at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: user1@accslegro.com/user123 now exists in DB (created during iter_14). Preferences endpoint stores a free-form merged dict at users.preferences. Theme is applied by Layout useEffect calling api.getPreferences on mount. Testids used: nav-preferences, preferences-page, theme-light-btn, theme-dark-btn, reset-prefs-btn, prefs-summary-card, tab-{synthese|pnl|classe|custom}, sort-{key}, scenario-{ca|revue1|revue2}.

verified_scenarios.per_user_isolation_admin_vs_user1: PASS — admin remained dark after user1 switched his own to light

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issue. Only note: PUT /api/me/preferences returns 500 (not 400) on malformed JSON body due to unhandled JSONDecodeError from `await request.json()`.
